description: This PHP class defines the Root node for a documentation tree structure in the Daux documentation generator, managing configuration and active nodes within the documentation hierarchy.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root directory of a documentation tree, extending Directory, with configuration and active node management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Root object with a configuration, sets URI and path based on the documentation directory, and initializes the active node.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object associated with this root.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration object for this root.

methods.name: isHotPath
methods.description: Determines if a given node is on the current 'hot path' based on the active node, returning true or false.

methods.name: setActiveNode
methods.description: Sets the active node within the tree.
